title: Ceremonial Error Wrappers
pattern: A custom error wrapper that simply stringifies upstream errors instead of categorizing errors or carrying semantic context.
why_bad: Erases the original error types, stack traces, and recovery opportunities, replacing rich structured error handling with fragile string matching.
detection: A custom error wrapper whose conversion implementations only invoke `.to_string()` or `.to_string().into()` on upstream errors.
counterexample: Domain-specific errors that map concrete error variants to logical domain failures (e.g., `PaymentFailed`).
fix: Propagate the original error directly, or use an error-handling library like `thiserror` to define rich structured errors.
